title: ZineOptions
description: Constructor options for the Zine flipbook: new Zine(container, options).

source.description: Content source resolving page indices to rasters, e.g. new ImageSource(urls). Required; a runtime object, not JSON-serializable.

width.description: Fixed container width in px; omit to let the container/CSS drive the size.

height.description: Fixed container height in px; omit to let the container/CSS drive the size.

renderer.description: Which renderer to use. Default 'auto' (prefer GPU, else CSS).

oneOf.description: Ordered fallback list; the first available renderer wins.

spreadMode.description: How pages group into spreads: 'double' (paired from page 0), 'single' (one per spread), 'cover' (lone first page), 'book' (lone first and last).

curl.description: Page-curl model for the WebGL2 renderer: 'roll' (roll up then flop over; a lone page turns the same way and dissolves as it lands), 'cone' (natural conical curl, PARC/iBooks-style, anchored at tap; default), 'leaf' (traveling smooth-curvature wave with flat paper before and after the bend, anchored at tap), 'flick' (inertial follow-through: the sheet trails the turn, then swings past and settles, anchored at tap), 'silk' (hand-turned S-curve: spine-driven rotation with body bend + free-edge reverse curl forming a true inflection, early peel lead, anchored at tap), 'simple' (plain flat page turn, no bend).

frontCover.description: Image URL prepended as a lone front cover (adds a page).

backCover.description: Image URL appended as a lone back cover (adds a page).

pages.description: Replace source pages with image URLs, keyed by 0-based source index (negative = from the end).

startPage.description: Zero-based page to open on; must be within the source's page count.

flipDuration.description: Flip animation duration in milliseconds. Timed for a two-page spread; a lone page stretches this and eases out harder (no facing half to land on).

clickToFlip.description: How a tap/click turns pages: near an edge, by page half, or off.

clickZoneSize.description: Edge-zone size in px per side, used when clickToFlip is 'edge'.

clickFlipDelay.description: Delay (ms) before a click flips, to let a double-click zoom preempt it. Omit for auto (0 when double-click zoom is inactive, 250 when active).

doubleClick.description: Zoom levels cycled by double-click (wraps); false to disable.

doubleClickInFlipZone.description: Listen for double-click zoom inside click-to-flip zones. Default: off in 'edge' mode, on in 'half'. Enabling it makes clicks wait out clickFlipDelay.

singlePageThreshold.description: Container widths (px) below this switch to one page per spread; 0 disables the responsive fallback.

deepLink.description: Keep the current page in the URL hash (#page=12), so a link opens where the reader was. Only the 'page' key is touched.

responsiveSpread.description: Whether a narrow container may override spreadMode and show one page at a time. False holds the configured mode at every width.

disableContextMenu.description: Suppress the browser's right-click menu over the book. A deterrent, not protection: the pages remain in the DOM.

controls.description: Built-in toolbar. true for the default set, false for none, or an object to configure it.

position.description: Which edge of the book the toolbar sits on.

docked.description: Sit outside the book in normal flow; false floats the toolbar over it.

items.description: Toolbar layout: control ids, '|' separators, or inline control definitions. Omit for the default set.

arrows.description: Large page-turn arrows flanking the book.

className.description: Extra class on the toolbar root, for styling.
